result.keywords: This article examines the cataloging and preservation of regional folklore artifacts associated with harbor festivals, focusing on hand-blown lanterns, oral sea-ballads, and archival exhibit design. It proposes a descriptive framework for organizing ethnographic collections that combines material analysis, conservation notes, and narrative provenance. Case studies from small museum repositories are used to compare documentation practices across coastal communities, with emphasis on climate-sensitive storage, digitization workflows, and interpretive labeling for public exhibitions.
result.title: Tidal Archives of Glass Lanterns in Coastal Folklore Collections.
